name: Replicate
label: Replicate
description: Official Replicate HTTP API v1 prediction runner (INPUT input → OUTPUT output). Not an Agent chat model — do not attach to the AI Agent model FUNCTION port. operation selects run (POST /v1/models/{owner}/{name}/predictions), predict (POST /v1/predictions), get_prediction, cancel, or list_models. Auth is StudioQuack secret api_token (r8_…) sent as Authorization Bearer. Docs: https://replicate.com/docs/reference/http. Terms: https://replicate.com/terms. Never log api_token.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. run needs owner, name, and nested input object. predict needs version (official owner/name or community version id) and nested input. get_prediction/cancel need prediction_id. list_models accepts cursor. Do not put api_token here.

schema.label: owner
schema.description: Model owner for operation=run (official path /v1/models/{owner}/{name}/predictions). Example: stability-ai.

schema.label: name
schema.description: Model name for operation=run. Example: sdxl.

schema.label: version
schema.description: 64-hex version id (or owner/name:hex) for operation=predict (POST /v1/predictions). Required by that path.

schema.label: input
schema.description: Model-specific prediction payload (the version openapi_schema). Nested object named input, not the port name. Example: {"prompt":"a red cube"}.

schema.label: stream
schema.description: predict. true requests SSE streaming when the model supports it.

schema.label: prediction_id
schema.description: Prediction id from create (e.g. gm3qorzd…) for get_prediction and cancel.

schema.label: cursor
schema.description: Pagination cursor for list_models (from previous next URL).

schema.label: webhook
schema.description: Request-body parameter `webhook` for operations: run, predict.

schema.label: webhook_events_filter
schema.description: Request-body parameter `webhook_events_filter` for operations: run, predict.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Prediction or model-list JSON. Success: {status,http_status,data}. Secrets redacted. OfficialApiNode does not poll — run returns the create response (often starting). Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: ok on HTTP 2xx. Absent on failure. Prediction object also has its own status: starting | processing | succeeded | failed | canceled | aborted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed Replicate JSON (prediction object or paginated models list).

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Official Replicate verb. EXACT values: run | predict | get_prediction | cancel | list_models. Default run = POST /v1/models/{owner}/{name}/predictions. predict = POST /v1/predictions (community version id).

configurationParameters.label: API Token
configurationParameters.description: Replicate API token (starts with r8_). Sent as Authorization: Bearer. StudioQuack secret binding only. Never logged. Empty → error 'api_token is required'.

configurationParameters.label: Version
configurationParameters.description: Community version id, `{owner}/{name}:{version_id}`, or official `{owner}/{name}` (POST /v1/predictions accepts all three since 2025-08-05). Also send on INPUT so OfficialApiNode includes it in the JSON body. https://replicate.com/docs/reference/http#predictions.create

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Single HTTP call timeout (create/get/cancel). Default 60. Floor 1. OfficialApiNode does not poll after Prefer wait.
